content.short: Privacy Cash enables private transfers of SOL, ETH and USDC.
content.description: Privacy Cash allows transfers of SOL, ETH and USDC without linking sender and recipient addresses publicly, and operates on Robinhood Chain among others. Transaction privacy carries real regulatory weight after previous enforcement actions in this category, and it remains an unsettled area rather than a solved one.
